title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
description: Declaration of Unit Sale Price in Rupees per g / kg / ml / l / cm / m or per number/unit, according to the threshold: mass < 1 kg in per g, >= 1 kg in per kg; volume < 1 L in per ml, >= 1 L in per l; length < 1 m in per cm, >= 1 m in per m; items sold by number in per piece/number, rounded to up to two decimal places.

source.instrument: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Second Amendment) Rules, 2021 read with 2022 Amendment
